name: wise-mcp
description: Read your Wise balances, card payments, transfers and recipients, and prepare transfers you approve twice.
long_description: Connects Claude to your Wise account with a personal API token. Read balances, Jars, card payments, transfers, recipients and exchange rates across your personal and business profiles. With a Full access token, Claude can also prepare transfers, recipients and cancellations: every change needs your explicit approval in chat, and transfers are created unpaid, so money only moves when you pay them in the Wise app. Independent project by BlanketByte, not operated by Wise.

wise_api_token.title: Wise API token
wise_api_token.description: Wise → Settings → API tokens → Add new token. Full access lets Claude prepare transfers and recipients; Read only is enough for answers.

writes_enabled.title: Allow preparing transfers and recipients
writes_enabled.description: Every change still needs your approval in chat, and transfers are paid by you in the Wise app. Turn off for read-only.

max_transfer_amount.title: Max amount per transfer (optional)
max_transfer_amount.description: In the source currency. Leave empty for no limit.
